lead_raw_text:
The structure of NiCoGeO4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms (Ni4Co4Ge4O16) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Ni each in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Ge adopts a tetrahedral coordination of four O atoms; O centers have five geometric neighbors (Co, Ge, Ni). Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Co and Ni octahedra, edge-sharing between Co and Ni octahedra, and corner-sharing between Ge tetrahedra and both Co and Ni octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
